_comment: Candidate creature coats, OFF by default (scripts/creatures/creature_body.gd _apply_coat_flags). An enabled flag maps an ordinary coat's live albedo path to a graded file; an emission slot carrying the same image follows it; shiny bodies are untouched. The GPU judges an arm by flipping enabled; the graded files need an import like any new texture.

creatures_f36_coat_lift._why: CREATURES-F36 (31 Oct). GPU ROSTER-1 High (coordinator): cindercub 7.13, duskhush 6.77 and ashtusk 6.68 want a value lift and rim; GPU CO12 (31 Oct): thundertunnel 6.49 / 6.50 is still 'a dark mound with no readable face' after its first lift. Grades from tools/art_pipeline/grade_coat_value.py.

creatures_f36_coat_lift_2._why: CREATURES-F36 batch 2 (31 Oct). GPU roster 24 Oct: shadelet 6.29 'near-black, no rim light; silhouette dissolves', stormtrail 5.98 'flat black placeholder dog'; CO12 31 Oct: nightburrow 6.67 'coat noisy and speckled'. Same grade as creatures_f36_coat_lift (tools/art_pipeline/grade_coat_value.py), gentler on the night and storm variants.

creatures_f36_matte_finish._why: CREATURES-F36 (31 Oct). GPU roster 24 Oct off-style materials (R4): skyrill 6.33 'chrome-mirror skin', voltarach 6.87 'chrome-gold statue shader', sparkit 6.28 'flat mustard material', reedwing 6.78 'decal-like', cragclaw 6.40 'plasticky salmon skin'. Probed live materials: skyrill, sparkit and reedwing render metallic 1.0 over their metallic maps; voltarach takes its gloss from its roughness map. Matte: metallic off, a constant fur/hide roughness, lower specular.

creatures_vis_coat_fulgocobra._why: VIS-CREATURES (1 Nov). GPU roster 24 Oct (F36-1/roster-base-1e83cafa0): fulgocobra 6.38, 'dark brown on stage' (R2 value and rim). Value lift as the landed coat lifts (CO16: +0.5 to +1.0 on dark coats). Grade: tools/art_pipeline/grade_vis_creatures.py.

creatures_vis_coat_cannonback._why: VIS-CREATURES (1 Nov). GPU roster 24 Oct: cannonback 6.92, 'brass-gear machinery shell reads as kitbash' (R4 off-style material); water_cannonback 6.72 (ROSTER-1). creatures_vis_coat_abyssal_guardian._why: VIS-CREATURES (1 Nov). GPU roster 24 Oct: abyssal_guardian 6.91, 'glossy vinyl-blue skin with regular dots; toy-like' (R4); water form 6.63. Cyan dots blend most of the way into the hide, the blue is a little deeper, and the self-lit emission drops to 0.6 so the stage light models the form. Grade: tools/art_pipeline/grade_vis_creatures.py.

creatures_vis_coat_veridian._why: VIS-CREATURES (1 Nov). GPU roster 24 Oct: veridian 6.63, 'moss noise'; GPU 1024: 'bone-white bands read as a skeleton'. White bands drop to warm ivory; moss smoothed (median) so it reads as growth. Grade: tools/art_pipeline/grade_vis_creatures.py.

creatures_vis_coat_voltarach._why: VIS-CREATURES (1 Nov). GPU roster 24 Oct: voltarach 6.87 'chrome-gold statue shader; face lost'; CO34: 'a dark bronze/black base with thin gold arcs and readable blue eyes. Today the gold covers most of the body.' The gold halo darkens to bronze (arc cores keep their value), the black base lifts to dark bronze, the blue eyes brighten. Probed: its maps are already matte (metallic 0, roughness map mean 0.67), so the gold look is in the albedo, not the material values. Grade: tools/art_pipeline/grade_vis_creatures.py.

remake_owner1101_glow_read._why: CAUSE-REMAKES (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). GPU creature stage (1 Nov, three judges): the owner rule's fantasy element (glowing eyes plus element lines, veins or spots) does not read at gameplay distance on the remakes; only Brooktail's aqua spots showed (its map covers 2.8% of the texture at mean 0.76; Terrapup's 0.02%, eye dots only; Bramblebun's veins mean 0.52). One shared pass for all 47 remakes with a glow mask: the existing arc_emission mask (same hue choices) lit fully, a small halo inside the UV island for eye-only and thin-line masks (none above 2% coverage, so spots never become a body glow), purer element hue so Compatibility's LDR clip keeps the colour (warm glows held at hue 28+), emission energy 2.6 / 2.0 / 1.4 by coverage under 0.15% / under 2% / above. Bramblebun's core is rebuilt from its crevice veins (hue 112-155, about 3%; leaves stay unlit) at 2.0. Solmane and Tuskroot have no glow map (none in the concept / natural amber eyes). Real emission, not bloom: it reads with glow off. Script tools/art_pipeline/remake_owner1101_finish.py glow.

remake_owner1101_plate_blend._why: CAUSE-REMAKES (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). GPU creature stage: Terrapup's 'evenly tiled green plates look stuck on, generated'; Bramblebun's bark plates read 'like a plaster cast'. Terrapup: pale bevel rims flattened, stone tone varies between warm stone and moss across the body, moss in the crevices between tiles, plate edges darken into moss and dirt where they meet the coat. Bramblebun: grainy pale bark plates (region vote on carved-grain contrast, so the soft white belly and inner-ear fur stay) go warm brown (hue 28-36, saturation under 0.5, clear of Team Tether red) with grain kept, and moss creeps in from the veins and leaves. Eyes, veins and fur keep their pixels; mesh and UVs untouched. Script tools/art_pipeline/remake_owner1101_finish.py plate.

remake_owner1101_dark_lift._why: CAUSE-REMAKES (1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged). GPU creature stage: dark remake bodies (Brooktail, the black river otter; Voltarach) sink into dark ground. The same value lift as creatures_f36_coat_lift (dark low-saturation texels x1.35-1.4 plus 0.03, feathered; eyes, mouth line and the saturated aqua spots and blue sparks keep their pixels), gentle enough to keep the black identity. Pairs with remake_owner1101_glow_read (its emission map applies over the lifted albedo). Script tools/art_pipeline/grade_coat_value.py brooktail_owner1101 voltarach_owner1101.
